sources.description: The Denver Broncos enter this week with a couple of lingering injuries from their running back position group. RJ Harvey was held out last week with a hamstring, but both JK Dobbins and Jonah Coleman were dealing with injuries that came up during their win over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
